name: Jitters' Growling Gut
summary: In Raven Hill, Jitters is starving and afraid, with only weeds and insects to eat. He asks you to go east to Darkshire and seek a hot batch of Chef Grual’s famous Dusky Crab Cakes.

sections.title: Starving in Raven Hill
sections.body: Raven Hill’s ruined streets shelter ravenous undead and lurking beasts. Jitters has hidden there for weeks, moving through its crumbling shanties under a sky that never seems to brighten. Grubs from the dirt and wild weeds are all he has found to eat. Hunger and fear wear him down, far from the comforts of ordinary life.

sections.title: A Plea for Crab Cakes
sections.body: Jitters longs for a taste of safety: the seasoned patties made at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. He asks you to cross the haunted road and speak with Chef Grual. If the chef agrees to make Dusky Crab Cakes, a hot meal may quiet Jitters’ growling gut.

faq.answer: Jitters is a frightened, paranoid man hiding in the ruined township of Raven Hill in western Duskwood. The undead there terrify him, and he fears starvation and slaughter.

faq.q: Where can I find Chef Grual?
faq.answer: Chef Grual works in the kitchen of the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire, on Duskwood’s eastern side.
Jitters has spent weeks trapped in ruined Raven Hill, cut off from civilization by roaming undead and predatory worgen. With no provisions, he scavenges insects and foliage to survive.

aliases: what does jitters want to eat
faq.answer: Jitters wants Dusky Crab Cakes, a local specialty Chef Grual prepares at the Scarlet Raven Tavern.

faq.q: What happens after speaking with Chef Grual?
faq.answer: Chef Grual agrees to cook for Jitters, but he has no fresh ingredients. He asks you to gather gooey spider legs for the Dusky Crab Cakes.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this quest?
faq.answer: No. Jitters and Darkshire are aligned with the Alliance, so only Alliance adventurers can help him.

angles.text: Chef Grual’s Dusky Crab Cakes show how cooks in Duskwood use local, unusual ingredients when regular shipments fail to arrive.
Helping Jitters brings you closer to the fragile settlements and survivors holding on in Duskwood’s shadowed corners.
